notes.title: Candy Raid: The Factory Linux Release!
notes.notes:
For the last couple weeks, my artist and I have been tweaking and updating Candy Raid: The Factory, adding the few Quality of Life features that have been asked of us repeatedly. Well, you asked for it! Ahead of it's second anniversary, Candy Raid: The Factory now has a main menu, a pause screen, and a proper level select!

...so that may not interest everyone, but something I am excited about is that we've finally released the game on Linux! A few people in our circle of friends asked for this, so we finally obliged. Now you can take the game multiplatform!

Speaking of multiplatform, I'd also like to announce that we're not stopping here! We're currently planning on releasing Candy Raid: The Factory on none other than the Nintendo Switch! We're hoping for an October 1st release date, but that will be cutting it close, considering we'll be working on new hardware. But, regardless of the date, we'll be releasing there soon. Soon-ish.
